name: Zalaszentgrót (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Zalaszentgrót (a red shield with a white armoured arm holding a sabre, within a yellow baroque frame and a green wreath) above the name ZALASZENTGRÓT in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zalaszentgrót arms with frame and wreath
